# Every commit that was already published on GitHub at the cutoff, by full SHA, one per line:
# the complete ancestry of all 88 refs the repository advertised on 2026-10-05 (55 branches,
# 33 refs/pull/N/head, tag v0.3.0), excluding refs/heads/claude/metadata-guard (this change).
# Same scope and same mirror snapshot as private_infra_commit_exceptions.txt; the sha256 of
# the scope's `git show-ref --dereference` listing is
# 79b91f06e7dc8dd65eb40b0738f912dd31a9dde1ce6a2210f393736cee3e1121.
# Built with: git -C <mirror> rev-list --exclude=refs/heads/claude/metadata-guard --all
#
# Meaning: the trees of these commits are already public and are not rescanned when they
# appear in a pushed commit's history (owner ruling 2026-10-05, "no rewrite"). That is not
# approval of anything in them. Every commit NOT listed here is new and its whole tree must
# be clean, including content it reuses from these old commits; every pushed tip's tree is
# scanned even when the tip itself is listed. The boundary is never extended from remote
# refs. The file is pinned by PUBLICATION_BOUNDARY_SHA256 in check_private_infra.py.
